dnsmasq_config.content:
except-interface=lo
# don't read DNS settings from normal resolv.conf
resolv-file=/etc/dnsmasq.d/dnsmasq-resolv.conf
dnsmasq_config.name: custom

auditd_rules_all.comment: ## Successful and unsuccessful attempts to read information from the audit records
## Modifications to audit configuration that occur while the audit collection functions are operating
# Monitor for use of audit management tools
## We put these early because audit is a first match wins system.
## Ignore EOE records (End Of Event, not needed)
# Cron jobs fill the logs with stuff we normally don't want (works with SELinux)
# This prevents chrony from overwhelming the logs
#-a never,exit -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -F auid=unset -F uid=chrony -F subj_type=chronyd_t
# This is not very interesting and wastes a lot of space if the server is public facing

auditd_rules_all.rule: -a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S finit_module -S init_module -S delete_module -F auid!=-1 -k T1215_Kernel_Modules_and_Extensions
-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S finit_module -S init_module -S delete_module -F auid!=-1 -k T1215_Kernel_Modules_and_Extensions
-a exit,always -F arch=b32 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k T1099_Timestomp
-a exit,always -F arch=b64 -S adjtimex -S settimeofday -S clock_settime -k T1099_Timestomp

-a always,exit -F arch=b32 -S rmdir -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid=0 -k T1070_Indicator_Removal_on_Host
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S rmdir -S unlink -S unlinkat -S rename -S renameat -F auid=0 -k T1070_Indicator_Removal_on_Host

policy: THIS POLICY HAS TO BE THE LAST

vda.host: SCSI storage controller: Red Hat, Inc. Virtio block device

ansible_facts.facter_ec2_userdata:
Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="MIMEBOUNDARY"
MIME-Version: 1.0

--MIMEBOUNDARY
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="init.cfg"
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 7bit
Content-Type: text/cloud-config
Mime-Version: 1.0

system_info:
  default_user:
    name: ait
    plain_text_passwd: test
    lock_passwd: False

write_files: 
-  encoding: b64     
   content:      
   owner: root:root     
   path: /root/ifsetup.sh     
   permissions: '0700'

runcmd:
  -  [apt-get, update]
  -  [apt-get, install, -y, python, dnsmasq]
  -  "echo 'bind-interfaces' > /etc/dnsmasq.d/bind-interfaces"
  -  [iptables, -P, FORWARD, ACCEPT]
  -  [iptables, -t, nat, -A, POSTROUTING, -o, ens3, -j, MASQUERADE]
  -  [ /root/ifsetup.sh ]
  -  "echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward"
  -  [systemctl, restart, dnsmasq]

--MIMEBOUNDARY--
